This 57-residue protein is dense with cysteines, resembling a toxin or defensin-like fold. I'm examining the sequence pattern and checking CA distances to see if there's a helical segment near the start.

Checking more CA-CA distances across the chain, they all come out extended rather than helical, suggesting this is predominantly a beta-sheet fold — consistent with a three-finger toxin-like architecture given the disulfide-rich sequence. I'll double-check whether any short helical stretch might still be present somewhere in the structure.
